title: Squirrel with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- tail -->
    <path d='M 60 70 Q 85 68 88 45 Q 90 25 72 22 Q 55 20 50 38 Q 47 52 58 58 Q 66 62 72 52 Q 78 42 70 36 Q 64 32 60 40 Q 58 46 64 48' fill='#e07b39' stroke='#ffb070' stroke-width='3' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
    <!-- tail fluff highlight -->
    <path d='M 74 30 Q 82 34 80 46 Q 78 56 68 56' fill='none' stroke='#ffcf9e' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='46' cy='68' rx='16' ry='18' fill='#e07b39'/>
    <!-- belly -->
    <ellipse cx='46' cy='73' rx='9' ry='11' fill='#ffe0a3'/>
    <!-- front legs -->
    <ellipse cx='38' cy='80' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#c05f22'/>
    <ellipse cx='54' cy='80' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#c05f22'/>
    <!-- ears -->
    <ellipse cx='36' cy='40' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#e07b39' stroke='#ffb070' stroke-width='2'/>
    <ellipse cx='56' cy='40' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#e07b39' stroke='#ffb070' stroke-width='2'/>
    <ellipse cx='36' cy='41' rx='2.5' ry='4' fill='#ffe0a3'/>
    <ellipse cx='56' cy='41' rx='2.5' ry='4' fill='#ffe0a3'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx='46' cy='48' r='14' fill='#e07b39'/>
    <!-- cheeks -->
    <circle cx='38' cy='52' r='4' fill='#ffb070'/>
    <circle cx='54' cy='52' r='4' fill='#ffb070'/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx='41' cy='47' r='3.5' fill='#3a2418'/>
    <circle cx='51' cy='47' r='3.5' fill='#3a2418'/>
    <!-- sparkles in eyes -->
    <circle cx='42' cy='45.5' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <circle cx='52' cy='45.5' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <circle cx='40' cy='48.5' r='0.8' fill='#bff4ff'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='48.5' r='0.8' fill='#bff4ff'/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <circle cx='46' cy='52' r='1.8' fill='#8a3b12'/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d='M 42 55 Q 46 58 50 55' fill='none' stroke='#8a3b12' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- little paws/acorn -->
    <ellipse cx='43' cy='62' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#c05f22'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#c05f22'/>
    <circle cx='46.5' cy='61' r='2.4' fill='#a8663a'/>
    <path d='M 44.5 59.5 Q 46.5 58 48.5 59.5' fill='none' stroke='#7a4a26' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
